page.intro: MTGO's log does not say which deck you played. These matches are grouped by the saved list that holds the most cards you played in each; confirm a group and every match in it counts toward that list.
page.noMatches: No MTGO matches yet. Arena's log names the deck it played, so Arena matches never need this page.
page.allDone: Every MTGO match has a deck.

sure.title: Fits a saved list
sure.caption: Each list holds at least nine in ten of the cards you played.

partial.title: Close to a saved list
partial.caption: The list holds half or more of the cards you played, not all. Often a version you changed or never saved; confirm only if close enough is right for you.

unsure.title: Pick one at a time
unsure.caption: Too few cards, or no saved list fits. Open the match to pick a deck, or just its format.
